# External data

`getdeploying_weekly.json` is an unmodified copy of the frozen GPU rental price snapshot
shipped with [GPU_Depreciation_Research](https://github.com/uwecerron/GPU_Depreciation_Research)
(`anc/data/weekly.json`), from [GetDeploying GPU rental price history](https://getdeploying.com/dataset/gpu-prices),
distributed under [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). No endorsement is implied.
Prices are estimates in USD per GPU-hour. This study uses only the `nvidia-h100` on-demand weekly median.
